generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Build benchmark datasets, harnesses, workloads, baselines, metric implementations, and comparison scripts.

contract.purpose_user_function: Construct benchmark datasets, workloads, baselines, metric implementations, and harness configurations.
contract.valid_inputs: Benchmark specification, tasks/dataset, solver/operator adapter, metrics/baseline, budget, environment, and expected result schema.
contract.expected_outputs: Registered benchmark assets and a doctor/plan/run-capable harness definition.
contract.state_side_effects: Writes benchmark registration/task/adapter/config artifacts; execution is separate.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Invalid task/schema, missing solver, contaminated/unlicensed dataset, incorrect metric, or unbounded workload blocks registration.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Benchmark runner/reporting framework is shipped; authoring arbitrary new datasets/workloads is a developer task.
contract.success_evidence: Doctor/list/plan/run accepts the assets, result schema validates, and baseline/metric behavior is independently checked.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: registry entry; dataset/task validation; solver adapter; metric; baseline; contamination/license; doctor/run smoke.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md §Basic Workflow and Appendix AutoSci Commands; docs/WORKFLOW_DESIGN.md Phases 2-5; AGENTS.md Scope and Local Workflow
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Solar ships primarily as a Claude Code overlay. Concrete builds depend on selected physical operators, language toolchains, credentials, datasets, hardware, and approval/write-scope policy.

implementation.interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
